facts.anchor: Catherine has never been to Europe
In line to board the plane, she can feel her heart racing
facts.fact: 她在排队登机时心跳加速。

facts.anchor: Butterflies feel like love, but they come from fear. Fear of love not being requited
facts.fact: 她那种蝴蝶般的感觉像爱，却源自对爱得不到回应的恐惧。

facts.anchor: When she was twenty-one, Elisabeth was already crawling
facts.fact: 她二十一岁那年，伊丽莎白已经会爬了。

facts.anchor: Catherine never got to have this freedom, this youth
facts.fact: 凯瑟琳从未拥有过这份自由和青春。

facts.anchor: It is the most natural thing in the world for a child to grow beyond
facts.fact: 她认为孩子超越父母是世上最自然的事。

facts.anchor: She would never call this feeling envy
facts.fact: 她绝不会把这种感觉称为嫉妒。
